evidence: Audited natural-fit has better system meanF1/min33 but old-natural five-way accuracy90.2253%→83.4058% and CoT recall79.5722%→64.0534%; old tailF1 also regressed. This motivates preserving non-system discrimination, not claiming a solved system boundary.

methods.method: Frozen non-system conditional + specialized bounded binary system residual
formula: r=sigmoid(a_old+delta); p=[r,(1-r)*q_old]. Implement via frozen old5 logits plus delta only on z0, retaining the original numerical path for zero-start parity.
methods.preservation: All non-system logit differences are unchanged. The conditional CoT/user/assistant/tool ranking is fixed; a formerly correct non-system CoT winner cannot become assistant within that branch. Full argmax can still flip CoT→system, so five-way accuracy is not automatically guaranteed.
methods.tail_boundary: System P/R/F1/BAcc depend only on r and tau. Frozen q cannot fix tail binary errors. Copying current new r with old q would reproduce its failed tailF1 exactly; no such p splice was evaluated.
methods.minimal_trial: One fixed512→32→1 residual, bound4, binary BCE only; old base/scaler frozen. New and exact same-role matched arms use641493 instances,157updates/epoch,last2517,seed20261021,max45/min10/patience8. Keep current source/components/slots. Old5-only early-stop and freeze best/history/GPUold before C4/public prediction. No anchor/architecture/bound/seed search.
methods.why_binary: With q fixed, five-class CE equals binary BCE plus a non-system -log(q_old[y]) constant. PublicSUA supervision can adapt system detection without retraining CoT-versus-assistant discrimination. A finite non-system KL-distillation alternative is softer and lacks this ordering guarantee; it is not an additional candidate here.
